faq.headline: Education Website FAQs
faq.description: Clear answers to help you plan and publish your education site.

items.question: Can students take a course on the website?
items.answer: You can present courses and collect enquiries. A learning management system, lessons, and student portal are not included.

items.question: Can I list course dates and fees?
items.answer: Yes. Add the details you provide and update them when terms change.

items.question: Can I accept applications?
items.answer: A form can gather initial interest; manage admissions and sensitive records through an appropriate system.

items.question: Can I explain course levels and learning formats?
items.answer: Yes. Describe the subjects, levels, prerequisites, schedule, format, and fees you can keep accurate.

items.question: Can students enroll or pay for a course on the site?
items.answer: The page can present courses and collect enquiries. It does not include a learning platform, student account, or built-in course payment flow.

items.question: Can I collect student or parent information?
items.answer: A general enquiry can collect initial contact details. Use an appropriate, privacy-reviewed process for children’s information, applications, and education records.
